instruction: Cinematic sparring still, full shot. Inside a smoky MMA gym with metal rigs and a red wall mural, two fighters square off. On the left, the shirtless man in black shorts (R1) stands in a defensive boxing stance with black gloves raised, facing right. On the right, the bearded shirtless man in patterned leggings (R3) stands in a matching stance with green gloves raised, facing left. The two men maintain distance, looking at each other with focused expressions. Cool overhead spotlights cut through the misty air, creating a dramatic, high-contrast atmosphere.
